crossRefs.note: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
“ ‘If they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against…
But Yahweh was gracious to them, and had compassion on them, and had respect for them, because of his covenant with…
salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us;
to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,
Relent, Yahweh! How long? Have compassion on your servants!
For Yahweh will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.
So Yahweh turned away from the evil which he said he would do to his people.
For Yahweh will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone; that…
When Yahweh raised up judges for them, then Yahweh was with the judge, and saved them out of the hand of their enemies…
When the angel stretched out his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, Yahweh relented of the disaster, and said to the…
“How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I make you…
Yahweh relented concerning this. “It shall not be,” says Yahweh.
Yahweh relented concerning this. “This also shall not be,” says the Lord Yahweh.
Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out…
Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.
I will tell of the loving kindnesses of Yahweh and the praises of Yahweh, according to all that Yahweh has given to us…
For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

translations.web: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
translations.bsb: And He remembered His covenant with them, and relented by the abundance of His loving devotion.
translations.kjv: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
translations.asv: And he remembered for them his covenant, And repented according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.
